**Other information:**

JSDoc only, in `src/core/Config.mjs`; no runtime line changes.

- AC-1: the `initDescriptor` summary now names the keys it reads (`clone`, `cloneOnGet`, `isEqual`, `merge`, stored as `mergeStrategy`), and the `@param` tags match `Config.prototype` and `src/Neo.mjs`: `clone='deep'`, `cloneOnGet=null` (with what a null value does on read: `Date` cloned, `Array` shallow-sliced, plain objects as-is), `isEqual=Neo.isEqual`, `merge='replace'` typed `{Function|String}` with `'replace'`, `'shallow'`, `'deep'`, `'deepArrays'` or a `(defaultValue, instanceValue) => merged` function. Types use `{String}` like the `@member` tags above.
- AC-2: the class header says "Neo.mjs runtime engine".
- AC-3: `git diff` touches comment lines only, and `npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/config/ --config=test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs` passes (20 passed).

I checked the getter behaviour against `src/Neo.mjs` (the `instanceof Date` branch, the `cloneOnGet` opt-in branch and the legacy `Array.isArray` slice) and the merge strategies against `Neo.mergeConfig`.
